spinal infiltrations are a safe procedure if performed with the following precautions: 1) a complete and detailed anamnesis and clinical exam, with particular attention to the history of back and/or neck pain, 2) a careful selection of patients, 3) an adequate imaging assessment, 4) a careful needle placement, 5) an adequate volume of local anaesthetic injected and 6) the use of a non-ionic contrast agent to confirm needle placement.
